en-GB.tutorial_messages_orla_09: [shaking]My[shaking] Groove creates an area of [shaking]destruction! [short_pause]And it's amazin'!
en-GB.tutorial_messages_orla_10: And yours heals enemy units too! It's so--
en-GB.tutorial_messages_orla_11: Oh, boy! Da's Groove is ready!
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_01: We're gonnae defeat the Felheim troops and kick them out of that Barracks on the other side of the lake.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_02: That's right, son.[short_pause] I'll capture it right away.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_03: It seems that this particular Hideout can only recruit Riflemen.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_04: Not so fast, Orla. [short_pause]We seem to be low on funds...
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_05: You'll need to use that Thief to ransack the nearby Village for gold.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_06: Aye, but bear in mind that heavy bag will reduce your Thief's movement range.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_07: And did ye notice that ransacking a structure made it neutral?
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_08: A Thief will neutralise a structure, but they're not able to capture it.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_09: Now, ye need to bring the gold back to the Hideout - carefully. Thieves are vulnerable.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_10: Aye, but if yer Thief is defeated on their way back to the Hideout, ye'll lose all that gold.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_11: This Hideout belongs to me, so I receive any gold that gets deposited there.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_12: If there are multiple Hideouts on the map, check which Commander needs gold the most.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_13: I should have enough gold to recruit a Rifleman on ma next turn.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_14: Errol's right.[short_pause] Also, Riflemen can only load 3 ammo at a time.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_15: When you're low on ammo, you'll need to start thinking about reloading your rifle.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_16: We'd better keep our Spearmen together so we can make use of their crit.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_17: Looks like yer Groove is fully charged!
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_18: Now, I dinnae want to hear any bickerin' over whose Groove to use, or whose is best...
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_20: That's right! [short_pause]My Groove lets me propel an adjacent unit across the map. Friend or foe.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_21: The unit will take damage, and it will also damage any units close to where it lands.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_22: Most importantly, if it lands on terrain it can't normally traverse, it'll be defeated.
en-GB.tutorial_messages_wulfar_23: We really needed that Thief to secure us funds...
en-GB.tutorial_objective_01: Ransack the enemy Village with the Thief.
en-GB.tutorial_objective_02: Safely deposit the Thief's gold at the Hideout.
en-GB.tutorial_objective_03: Recruit a Rifleman from the Hideout.
en-GB.tutorial_objective_04: Defeat the Felheim units and clear out their Barracks.
en-GB.tutorial_victory_orla_01: We did it![short_pause] We beat the skellies!
en-GB.tutorial_victory_wulfar_01: Ye did well, both of ye.
